description: This file contains abstract base classes for unit testing request handling within the Orleans.Serialization.Invocation namespace. It defines various generic and non-generic classes for invoking methods asynchronously, handling responses, and managing method metadata, serving as a foundation for request invocation in serialization testing scenarios.

classes.name: UnitTestRequestBase
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for invocation requests, including methods for argument handling, invocation, disposal, and retrieving method metadata.

classes.name: UnitTestRequest
classes.description: Abstract class implementing a sealed override of Invoke(), handling invocation asynchronously, with an abstract method InvokeInner() for derived classes to implement request-specific invocation logic.

classes.name: UnitTestRequest<TResult>
classes.description: Generic abstract class for requests returning a result, implementing asynchronous invocation and response creation based on InvokeInner().

classes.name: UnitTestTaskRequest<TResult>
classes.description: Abstract class for requests returning a Task<TResult>, managing asynchronous invocation and response creation.

classes.name: UnitTestTaskRequest
classes.description: Non-generic abstract class for requests returning a Task, handling asynchronous invocation and response creation.

classes.name: UnitTestVoidRequest
classes.description: Abstract class for void requests, calling InvokeInner() synchronously and returning a completed response.

methods.name: GetArgumentCount
methods.description: Returns the number of arguments in the request; default is zero.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Sealed method that manages asynchronous invocation, including exception handling and response wrapping.

methods.name: InvokeInner
methods.description: Abstract method for derived classes to implement specific invocation logic.

methods.name: CompleteInvokeAsync
methods.description: Helper method to await the result of invocation and generate appropriate Response.

methods.name: GetTarget
methods.description: Returns the target object for the invocation.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the target object for the invocation.

methods.name: GetArgument
methods.description: Retrieves an argument by index; default throws if there are no arguments.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the request.

methods.name: GetMethodName
methods.description: Returns the name of the method being invoked.

methods.name: GetInterfaceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the interface that declares the method.

methods.name: GetActivityName
methods.description: Returns the activity name relevant to the request.

methods.name: GetInterfaceType
methods.description: Returns the Type object for the interface.

methods.name: GetMethod
methods.description: Returns the MethodInfo for the invoked method.
